description: Re-runs a settled luck-board round from its seeds and checks it against the recorded play: the server seed's hash committed before the play, your client seed, the nonce and the result (a play's `verify` from my_plays is exactly the input). No play with that server seed on the board fails. You can also re-run it yourself with @luckloop/core's verifyPlay.

playId.description: The play's id (optional; without it the play is found by its server seed)

name: verify_play
title: Verify a luck-board round
